description:
A 26-year-old Gong Joo gets trapped in a game a week before her first day at work. Of course, the game works perfectly until the end of the seven-day free trial! You can escape the game only by clearing the lengthy main quest! She falls in love at first sight with a mysterious and handsome man who was attacked by a bird. They decide to join forces and escape together. However, the game world is full of bugs and has frequent lags, which make the game even harder, and the beloved Ok-bun and the other party members start to feel like extra baggage to her. With the feeling of responsibility of having to be the group leader, she silently carries out the main guests in order to escape. "Please let me escape safely! I have to go to work!" A newcomer's desperate escape from a difficult game world in order to get to his new workplace begins!

**Original Webtoon:**
